scripts.postinstall: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api test:integration && corepack pnpm --dir apps/worker test:integration
scripts.test:ci: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm test:unit && corepack pnpm test:integration && corepack pnpm test:e2e
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --dir apps/web build && corepack pnpm --dir apps/api build && corepack pnpm --dir apps/worker build
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
